metadata.question: Was nighttime light intensity lower on March 24, 2019, compared to March 9, 2019, in Beira and Manga, Mozambique?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about nighttime light intensity comparison between two specific dates (March 9, 2019 vs March 24, 2019) in two cities in Mozambique (Beira and Manga). For nighttime lights, the best dataset is VIIRS DNB (Day/Night Band) which provides daily nighttime light data. I should use the "NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG" collection which contains daily data. Strategy: 1. Define points for both cities (Beira and Manga, Mozambique) 2. Get VIIRS DNB images for both dates 3. Check if images exist for both dates 4. Extract nighttime light values (avg_rad band) for both locations 5. Compare the values and determine if March 24 was lower than March 9 Data quality considerations: - Check if images exist for both dates (C1 if missing) - Check if valid pixels exist (C2 if all masked) - Validate the values are reasonable (not NaN, not extreme outliers) Since this is nighttime light data, cloud masking is not typically needed as the VIIRS DNB already accounts for this in its processing. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define cities in Mozambique const beira = ee.Geometry.Point([34.8386, -19.8333]); // Beira coordinates const manga = ee.Geometry.Point([37.5, -15.0667]); // Manga coordinates const cities = ee.FeatureCollection([ee.Feature(beira), ee.Feature(manga)]); // Define dates const date1 = '2019-03-09'; const date2 = '2019-03-24'; // Get VIIRS DNB nighttime light data const collection = ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filter(ee.Filter.date(date1, '2019-03-10')) .merge(ee.ImageCollection('NOAA/VIIRS/DNB/MONTHLY_V1/VCMCFG') .filter(ee.Filter.date(date2, '2019-03-25'))); // Check collection size const size = collection.size().getInfo(); if (size === 0) { print("No nighttime light images found for either date."); print("C1"); return; } // Get individual images const img1 = ee.Image(collection.filter(ee.Filter.date(date1, '2019-03-10')).first()); const img2 = ee.Image(collection.filter(ee.Filter.date(date2, '2019-03-25')).first()); // Check if both images exist const img1Exists = img1.bandNames().size().getInfo() > 0; const img2Exists = img2.bandNames().size().getInfo() > 0; if (!img1Exists || !img2Exists) { print(`March 9 image exists: ${img1Exists}, March 24 image exists: ${img2Exists}`); print("C1"); return; } // Extract nighttime light values (avg_rad band) for both cities const extractValues = function(image, dateStr) { const stats = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: cities, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const beiraVal = stats.avg_rad || 0; const mangaVal = stats.avg_rad || 0; // Using same value for both since geometry covers both // Check for valid pixels const count = image.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: cities, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('avg_rad').getInfo(); return {value: (beiraVal + mangaVal) / 2, count: count, date: dateStr}; }; const val1 = extractValues(img1, "March 9"); const val2 = extractValues(img2, "March 24"); // Check for valid pixels if (val1.count === 0 || val2.count === 0) { print(`Valid pixels - March 9: ${val1.count}, March 24: ${val2.count}`); print("C2"); return; } // Validate values if (val1.value === null || val2.value === null || isNaN(val1.value) || isNaN(val2.value) || val1.value < 0 || val2.value < 0) { print(`Invalid values - March 9: ${val1.value}, March 24: ${val2.value}`); print("C3"); return; } // Print results and determine answer print(`March 9 light intensity: ${val1.value.toFixed(4)}`); print(`March 24 light intensity: ${val2.value.toFixed(4)}`); print(`March 24 is lower: ${val2.value < val1.value}`); if (val2.value < val1.value) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
